notes: The extraction is thorough and accurate on the P&L figures, prices, staffing, seasonality and startup costs, and its evidence and promotion flags are reasonable. The main gaps were a missing special-tier price point and a merch revenue-share claim that was folded into the margin claim instead of standing alone. Some figures are inconsistent and only approximate. The headline '$40k/month' is above the implied average of about $34k/month from $408.5k a year. Store 85%, truck 15% and merch about 20% do not add up, and the host admits the line items do not reconcile. An A rating is borderline; B would also be defensible.
